info.description:
Shipment management API for Logitech: staff record the items a customer brings in with the payment taken and any balance, the destination branch receives them or raises an exception, and the owner sees shipments, revenue, daily collections and outstanding balances.

## Demo / Seed Credentials

Every seeded staff account uses PIN `demo1234`. Use `POST /api/auth/login` with `staff_id` + `pin`.

### System Admin
Use `POST /api/auth/admin/login` with:

| Field    | Value             |

| password | adminpassword123  |

The system admin can also log in via the unified `POST /api/auth/login` endpoint by sending `staff_id: "admin"` (or the admin username) together with `password` instead of `pin`.

post.description:
Authenticate as system administrator using credentials configured in environment.

### Demo credentials

| Field    | Value            |
|----------|------------------|
| username | admin            |
| password | adminpassword123 |

Authenticate a staff member using their `staff_id` and `pin`.

### Normal login (PIN already set)
Send `staff_id` + `pin` only.

### First login / after a PIN reset
1. Call this endpoint with `staff_id` + `pin` (the one-time password).
The API responds 400 with `"provide new_pin"` in the error message.
2. Call again with `staff_id` + `pin` (OTP) + `new_pin` (4-10 chars).
The OTP is consumed; `new_pin` becomes the permanent PIN.

Account locks after **3** failed attempts; a branch manager or owner must unlock it.

---
### Seed / demo credentials (PIN = `demo1234` for all)

| staff_id | Full name      | Role    |

GAL-014 and GAL-015 have `first_login_done = false` (first-login flow required).
Invalidate the current session token using Redis token revocation.

get.description: Returns the profile and role details of the currently authenticated user.
Retrieve a list of all branches.

post.description: Creates a new branch. Only the owner (or system admin) can manage branches.

put.description: Updates branch details. Only the owner (or system admin) can manage branches.

delete.description: Marks a branch inactive (soft delete, its data is retained). Only the owner (or system admin) can manage branches.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all drivers.

post.description: Creates a new driver. Only the owner (or system admin) can manage drivers.

put.description: Updates driver details. Only the owner (or system admin) can manage drivers.

delete.description: Marks a driver inactive (soft delete, its data is retained). Only the owner (or system admin) can manage drivers.

get.description: Lists exceptions newest first. Owners and the system admin see all branches; managers and staff see exceptions touching their own branch. Filters: status, severity, type, branch_id, from/to (created_at), limit.

get.summary: Get an exception with its history

post.description: Adds a comment to the exception history and optionally moves it to another status or reassigns it. Resolving or closing the last open exception on a record returns the record to its delivery status (received, or in transit when it never arrived).
post.summary: Comment on, reassign or resolve an exception

get.description: Retrieve a list of all fleet vehicles.

post.description: Creates a new fleet vehicle. Only the owner (or system admin) can manage fleet.

put.description: Updates fleet vehicle details. Only the owner (or system admin) can manage fleet.

delete.description: Marks a fleet vehicle inactive (soft delete, its data is retained). Only the owner (or system admin) can manage fleet.

get.description: Returns a simple greeting message from the Logitech API server.
Retrieve a list of manager accounts. Accessible by the owner (and system admin), optionally filtered by branch.

post.description: Creates a manager account for a branch. Only the owner (or system admin) can manage managers. A staff_id is auto-generated and a one-time password is returned once, to be given to the manager for their first login.
Creates an owner account. Only the system admin can create owners. A staff_id is auto-generated and a one-time password is returned once, to be given to the owner for their first login.
Saves a captured image into the `photos` folder at the project root. The returned path can be stored on a record as photo_url.
post.summary: Upload a photo of a shipment taken with the camera

get.description: Lists shipment records newest first with the amount billed, the amount paid and the remaining balance. Owners and the system admin see every branch; managers and staff see records that originate from or are destined to their own branch. Optional filters: free text (tracking number, serial number, description, sender/receiver name or phone), status, payment_status, branch_id (origin or destination), origin_branch_id, destination_branch_id, from/to dates (created_at), and outstanding=true for records with a balance.

parameters.description: Tracking number, serial number, description, party name or phone
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Only records with an unpaid balance
parameters.name: outstanding

post.description: The sender-side flow: a staff member records the item(s) a customer brings in, the destination branch, the amount charged and the payment taken at the counter. Any unpaid remainder becomes the record's balance. Senders and receivers are matched on phone number, or created when they are new. When origin_branch_id is omitted the staff member's own branch is used.

get.description: Returns one record with its payment history and any exceptions raised against it.

put.description: Updates the receiver, destination, description, quantity or amount of a pending record. The amount cannot be lowered below what has already been paid. The sender and the origin branch are immutable.
put.summary: Edit a record that has not left the origin branch

post.description: Cancels a shipment that has not been received yet. Managers and the owner only.
Marks a pending record as in_transit when it leaves the origin branch. Origin-branch staff, their manager and the owner can call this.
post.summary: Mark a record as in transit

get.summary: List the exceptions of a record

post.description: The receiver-specific alternative to receiving cleanly: records what went wrong (missing, damaged, quantity mismatch, wrong goods ...) and flags the shipment as "exception". Defaults to the destination branch, or the origin branch when the sender raises it before dispatch.
post.summary: Raise an exception on a record

get.description: Returns every payment recorded against a shipment, oldest first.
get.summary: List the payments of a record

post.description: Adds a payment for a shipment (at the counter or when the balance is collected at the destination branch) and returns the record with the updated amount paid and remaining balance. A payment can never exceed the outstanding balance.
post.summary: Record a payment against a record

post.description: The receiver-side flow: staff at the destination branch confirm the quantity and condition actually received. Any remaining balance can be collected in the same call by sending a payment, which updates the balance and payment status. The record becomes "received"; use POST /api/records/:id/exceptions instead when goods are missing, damaged or wrong.
post.summary: Receive a record at the destination branch

get.description: Shipments sent and received, amounts billed, payments collected, unpaid balances and open exceptions for every branch. The owner sees all branches; a manager sees only their own.

One row per day in the period: how many shipments were recorded, how much was billed, how many payments were taken and how much was collected. The owner sees all branches; a manager sees their own branch.

Totals for the selected period (default: the last 30 days). The owner and system admin see every branch; a manager sees their own branch. "billed" is what was charged on records created in the period, "collected" is the payments taken in the period, and "outstanding" is the unpaid balance on all live records, plus today's collections and the exception backlog.
get.summary: Owner dashboard: shipments, revenue, collections, balances, exceptions

get.description:
Retrieve a list of staff members. Accessible by system_admin, owner, and manager.
Managers are always limited to the staff of their own assigned branch.

post.description:
Creates a staff member (role: staff) with a required job_role: operations, dispatch or receiving. Accessible to owners and managers only.
- Managers can only create staff in their own branch (branch_id is forced from their token).
- Owners can create staff in any branch.
A staff_id (e.g. GAL-001, prefix configurable via STAFF_ID_PREFIX) is auto-generated, and a one-time password is returned once so the user can log in and choose their personal PIN (max 10 chars).

get.description: Get details for a specific staff member by UUID. Staff can only fetch their own profile; managers only staff in their own branch.

put.description: Update a staff member's details. Managers can only update staff in their own branch; the owner can update anyone. Changing status (e.g. re-activating a revoked account) is owner/system admin only.

delete.description: Revokes a user's access by marking their account inactive. Managers can revoke staff in their own branch; the owner can revoke anyone.

get.description: Reports whether the staff has completed their first login (i.e. created their personal PIN), and when. Staff can query their own status; managers only staff in their own branch; the owner can query anyone.
get.summary: Check if a staff has performed their first login

post.description:
Generates a new one-time password for the user, invalidating their current PIN. The one-time password is returned once and must be given to the user, who uses it at login (with new_pin) to choose a new PIN. Any lockout on the account is cleared.
Managers can reset the PIN of staff in their own branch; the owner can reset any PIN.
Removes the lockout from an account that was locked after 3 failed login attempts. Managers can unlock staff of their own branch; the owner can unlock accounts across all branches.

get.description: Returns the service status and PostgreSQL database connection state.

amount_paid.description: AmountPaid is the payment taken at the counter when the item is recorded.

job_role.description: JobRole is required and must be one of operations, dispatch, receiving.

first_login_at.description: FirstLoginAt is set once the user has completed first login (RFC3339).

new_pin.description: NewPin is required on first login (and after a PIN reset) to create the personal PIN.

job_role.description: JobRole may be changed only for staff members; manager/owner accounts have none.

status.description: Status: "active" re-grants access (e.g. after a revoke); owner/system admin only.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and your JWT token.
